context: Two teens compare new cameras at the electronics store
purpose: Teach: ブラウザ/マウス/デジカメ/スイッチ/レンズ/液晶/割引/アフィリエイト

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 見て、この新しいデジカメ、液晶の発色めっちゃ綺麗じゃない？
lines.en: Look, this new digital camera, the LCD colors are super pretty, right?
lines.style: Excited teen girl pointing eagerly at the display case

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほんとだ、レンズも明るそうだし、画質よさそう。
lines.en: Yeah really, the lens looks bright too, the image quality seems good.
lines.style: Curious teen boy leaning in close to examine

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 電源スイッチどこだろ？あ、ここか。意外と小さいんだね。
lines.en: Where's the power switch? Oh, here. It's surprisingly small.
lines.style: Playful teen girl fumbling around the camera body

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 値段見た？学生割引使えば結構安くなるって。
lines.en: Did you see the price? Apparently with a student discount it gets pretty cheap.
lines.style: Practical teen boy checking the price tag carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: まじで？さっきパソコンのブラウザで価格比較してたけど、ここが一番安いかも。
lines.en: Seriously? I was comparing prices on my PC browser earlier, this might be cheapest.
lines.style: Thoughtful teen girl pulling out her phone to double-check

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: レビュー動画も見たけど、アフィリエイトの案件ばっかで微妙に信用できないんだよね。
lines.en: I watched review videos but they're all affiliate deals, kinda hard to trust.
lines.style: Skeptical teen boy with a knowing smirk and shrug

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 確かに。実物触れる方が安心だよね。マウスでポチるより店で見たかったし。
lines.en: True. Touching the real thing is more reassuring. Better than clicking with a mouse online.
lines.style: Decisive teen girl reaching toward her wallet pocket

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいじゃん、買っちゃえよ。撮ったらSNSに送って。
lines.en: Go for it, just buy it. Send me the photos on social after.
lines.style: Encouraging teen boy giving a casual thumbs up gesture
